system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
I got your offer for yearly premium payment (2 months off). But there is nothing to click/tap on the promo-page to subscribe. (And the promo won't pop up again in the app). How can I subscribe to the offer now? <link>

PREDICTED INTENT: subscription_manage

PRECEDENTS:

[2175395] (similarity 0.66, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: Is it not possible to purchase a premium subscription from the app? It's full of prompts that can't be acted on
  spotify replied: Hi Imola! You can subscribe from the app by tapping Your Library > the gear icon on the top right > Get Premium. Let us know how it goes

[632008] (similarity 0.66, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: how to avail this promo? <link>
  spotify replied: Hey Gian! The Intro Offer of ₱9 for 3 months is for those who haven't had Premium before. If you haven't been on a subscription in the past, head over to <link> to take this offer 😉

[2306969] (similarity 0.63, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: how on earth do you upgrade to premium using the iPhone app? Nothing to click on on account page... <link>
  spotify replied: Hey! We're afraid there's no option to subscribe to Premium on the app, but you can do so here: <link> Hope this helps

[149362] (similarity 0.63, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: How can i avail this kind of promo? <link>
  spotify replied: The 3 months for 9 PHP offer is for Spotify accounts which haven't been on Premium yet. Hope this info helps

[2779482] (similarity 0.62, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: how do I claim this offer? Nothing to click to purchase now. <link>
  spotify replied: Hey Allison! Can you try logging in to your account at <link> Afterwards, head over to <link> Let us know how it goes
